why_ai: Walkthroughs, handling, cataloguing and the live ring are done on site by an often-licensed auctioneer the consignor trusts, though online platforms absorb part of the sale.
why_clarity: The hammer grades every estimate within weeks, but the estimate itself is made by feel and each auctioneer does it differently.
why_digital: Physical goods valued and catalogued by hand, sold through online bidding, and picked up in person.

why_ai: Machines are inspected on site and guarantees carry real money, but serialised, comparable equipment is where pricing models are strongest.
why_clarity: Serial, hours and condition make lots comparable and hammers arrive weekly.
why_digital: Machines inspected in yards and sheds, sold through online timed and simulcast auctions to remote bidders.

why_ai: Executors hand a parent's house to a local firm they trust, and the work of emptying it is physical and deadline-bound.
why_clarity: Outcomes are exact dollars, but lotting and valuation differ by auctioneer and every house is different.
why_digital: A physical household sorted and lotted on site, sold online, collected in person.

why_ai: Sorting, carrying, photographing and cleaning out a full house is hands-on work in an unstructured place.
why_clarity: Crew-days, lots and net per house are measurable and the loop repeats, though houses vary widely.
why_digital: Work starts and ends in a physical house with local crews; only the bidding is online.

why_ai: Consignors choose a specialist they trust, and attribution calls are novel, high-stakes and open to later challenge.
why_clarity: Estimates are graded by the hammer, but attribution is expert judgement and each important piece is one-off.
why_digital: Objects are examined in hand, while research, cataloguing and international bidding are largely online.

why_ai: A licensed broker-auctioneer trusted by the family runs a local sale of land that changes hands once in a generation.
why_clarity: Price per acre is exact and hammers come quickly, but sales are infrequent and each farm differs.
why_digital: Land, families and neighbours are local and the sale is often a live event with phone bidders.

why_ai: Court-retained auctioneers walk closed premises and answer to trustees and judges, but the assets are mostly commodity equipment.
why_clarity: Net proceeds against the estimate are exact and sales follow a standard court sequence.
why_digital: Physical assets on closed premises, with filings and bidding done online.

why_ai: The firm is one licensed auctioneer known across a few counties, doing every physical and personal task in the sale.
why_clarity: Sales repeat weekly in season, but the owner improvises each one by feel.
why_digital: Local consignors, barns and community halls, with online bidding bolted on.

why_ai: Disposal of retired public assets follows rules any competent contractor or marketplace can meet, and online marketplaces already serve it.
why_clarity: Surplus rules, asset classes and resale outcomes are codified and checkable.
why_digital: Physical vehicles and equipment, but declarations, listings and sales run mostly online and remotely.

why_ai: Photographing physical lots needs a person on site, but identification and description are exactly what vision-language models now draft.
why_clarity: Every lot follows the same photograph, identify, describe and categorise loop, with edit rates and disputes as feedback.
why_digital: Physical items in, digital listings out, produced on screens.

why_ai: Settlement arithmetic and reminders are routine and automatable; only pickup supervision needs someone on site.
why_clarity: Payments, statements and reconciliations either balance or they do not, after every sale.
why_digital: Payments and statements are digital; pickup is a physical handover.

why_ai: Appraisers are unlicensed but sign valuations lenders rely on, visit plants and warehouses, and are tested against recoveries when borrowers fail.
why_clarity: Liquidation values are checkable when collateral is sold, but liquidations are infrequent and assumptions vary by appraiser.
why_digital: Borrower data and site visits in, appraisal reports out, sold through national lender relationships.

why_ai: Consignors and buyers pay for named specialists' eyes, and attribution and estimate calls are novel and high-stakes.
why_clarity: Hammers grade estimates publicly, but attribution is expert judgement and important lots are one-off.
why_digital: Objects examined in person, with research, catalogues and international bidding online.

why_ai: Online disposal platforms under servicer contracts; pricing models and auction mechanics are readily automated.
why_clarity: Sale outcomes against reserves are exact and the process repeats across thousands of properties.
why_digital: Loan and property data in, online auctions out; the property itself still transfers physically.

why_ai: Software marketplaces whose models are the kind AI improves rather than replaces; network effects carry the business.
why_clarity: Search, conversion and take rate are measured continuously on millions of lots.
why_digital: Entirely digital platforms serving auctioneers and bidders remotely.

why_ai: Central pricing desks model serialised auction results on screens; guarantee calls carry stakes but are data-driven.
why_clarity: Forecasts are graded by hammers weekly across thousands of comparable lots.
why_digital: Auction data in, internal prices out, with territory staff carrying them to consignors.

why_ai: Compiling and indexing public auction results is directly automatable, and free archives compete.
why_clarity: Each result is a published fact entered the same way.
why_digital: Published results in, online subscriptions out.

why_ai: Underwriters and lenders carry the loss on their values, but the work is review of others' appraisals and auction evidence.
why_clarity: Values are tested only at claim, sale or default, years later.
why_digital: Appraisals and auction data reviewed on screen for private clients and borrowers.

why_ai: Courts and trustees hold statutory authority over sales and fees, which will not be delegated to software.
why_clarity: Procedures are codified, but fee and sale disputes resolve slowly case by case.
why_digital: Filings are digital; jurisdiction is fixed and hearings are in person.

why_ai: Graders handle every item and the grade carries a brand guarantee, though image-based grading is advancing.
why_clarity: Grades follow published scales on millions of near-identical items, with resubmissions as feedback.
why_digital: Physical items are mailed in from anywhere, graded by hand and returned encapsulated.

why_ai: A credentialed appraiser inspects in person and signs reports the IRS, courts and insurers rely on.
why_clarity: USPAP sets the method, but value conclusions vary by appraiser and are tested only on audit or claim.
why_digital: Objects inspected on site, reports written on screen, clients mostly local or referred.

why_ai: Licensing and discipline are statutory powers held by public boards.
why_clarity: Licensing steps are codified; complaint outcomes are slow.
why_digital: Applications and complaints handled on screen within a fixed state jurisdiction.

why_ai: Membership bodies valued for conventions, designations and lobbying, which members still attend in person.
why_clarity: Courses and designations repeat yearly, but advocacy outcomes are slow and diffuse.
why_digital: Education online and in person, with conventions and contests as live events.

why_ai: Credentialing bodies whose standards and courses are content AI can largely reproduce, protected by recognition.
why_clarity: Courses follow USPAP cycles and credential steps are codified.
why_digital: Courses and credential records delivered mostly online.

why_ai: Software products that AI-native competitors can rebuild; switching costs are the main protection.
why_clarity: Features either work on sale day or they do not, across thousands of sales.
why_digital: Software built and sold entirely online.

why_ai: Local operators still clear houses by hand, while the central brand's value is marketing and process.
why_clarity: Household sales repeat across markets with net proceeds as feedback.
why_digital: Physical households, local crews, and a central online sale.
